title: plugin-auth: invite-member accepts a blank role ("") and writes an invitation with role '' — under a wall, accepting it creates a membership with no org role
body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZZ5q3itDsK1WDVLyQ

立卡门: ① 产品缺陷，具名落点 + 复现（reach: HTTP，`POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member`，single 与 walled group 两种姿态各实测）
业务理由: 管理员或委派管理员用脚本或表单邀请成员时漏填角色，系统不报错，留下一条 ADR-0108 词表之外的邀请；在多组织部署里被邀请人接受后成为一个没有组织角色的成员，读不到本该读到的东西，管理员也看不出原因。未知角色（如 `superuser`）在同一接口会被 400 ROLE_NOT_FOUND 拒绝，唯独空串放行。
动手的读者: 拥有 `packages/plugins/plugin-auth` 的车道：在 `beforeCreateInvitation` / `invitation-role-cap.ts` 拒绝空角色（400，与未知角色同码），或明确规范化为 `member`。
查重: `invite-member empty role` 95 命中（无匹配）、`invitation role empty string` 75、`ROLE_NOT_FOUND invitation` 14、`invitation role validation vocabulary` 43（含已关）；最近邻 #24750（未知角色无错误码，已关）、#23945（角色上限拒绝码，已关），都不涉及空角色。
Batch-of: release-18.3.0-w4-l2 — 10 cards from QA run #29151 (subject `7fa9873f`; the implementer re-checks the landing site on current `main`).

QA-source: #29151 · identity-auth.invitation-scope-gates · observed beside the clauses

## What happens
On a stock showcase, an owner or delegated_admin sends `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member {"email":"x@example.com","role":""}` and gets 200; a `sys_invitation` row is written with `role:''`, status pending. On a walled boot (`OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group`, `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL`, `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`), the owner of a second organization invites with role `""`, the invitee signs up and calls `accept-invitation` → 200 member `{role:''}`; `sys_member` reads `role:''` and the session's positions are `["everyone"]` (no `org_member`). On single posture the accept keeps the sign-up's `member` row (adopt never lowers a grade), but the invitation still records `role:''` and reads `accepted`.

No privilege gain was observed: the blank member reads less, not more. Measured at framework `7fa9873f` (main, 2026-11-02).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase; sign in as admin (or a delegated_admin).
2. `POST /api/v1/auth/organization/invite-member {"email":"x@example.com","role":""}`.
3. **Expected:** 400 (ROLE_NOT_FOUND or a validation code) and no row, or the role normalised to `member`.
4. **Actual:** 200 and a pending `sys_invitation` with `role:''`. Contrast: `"role":"superuser"` → 400 ROLE_NOT_FOUND.

## Mechanism (read at 7fa9873f)
The vendor role check splits the role list and filters out empty entries (`better-auth/dist/plugins/organization/routes/crud-invites.mjs:102-103`), so a blank role yields no unknown role and passes. ObjectStack's issuer cap (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/invitation-role-cap.ts`) does not refuse a blank role either. ADR-0108 closes the vocabulary to owner / admin / delegated_admin / member.
